run_anli_k_shot_generation: run the ANLI dataset preprocessing to generate 16-shot few-shot data splits for multiple random seeds
create_anli_classification_dataset: create an ANLI classification dataset instance with entailment, neutral, and contradiction labels for NLI tasks
load_anli_hf_dataset: load the ANLI dataset from Hugging Face using the datasets library for natural language inference
map_anli_dataset_to_list: map an ANLI Hugging Face dataset split to a list of premise hypothesis tuples with classification labels
get_anli_train_test_lines: get training and test line tuples from the ANLI dataset using train_r1 and dev_r1 splits
